description: Renovate proposes every dependency update and merges it on its next run (platformAutomerge is off). No checks run on pull requests in this repository, and a pull request with no status counts as pending, so ignoreTests is on: the 3-day wait is the only gate. A new version waits three days after its release (minimumReleaseAge); fixes for vulnerability alerts skip the wait by Renovate's default. timestamp-optional lets an update from a registry that reports no release date through. See https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#minimumreleaseage

packageRules.description: An image rebuild (a new digest under the same tag) doesn't wait: Docker Hub dates a rebuild by the tag's last push, so a tag rebuilt about weekly would restart the clock each time and never clear the wait.
This action runs on a schedule with the DEPLOY_KEY secret, so an unreviewed release could run with that key: its updates stay manual.
